title.en: The app is now simply called OpenAgents

description.en: The desktop app, its installers and its downloads are now named OpenAgents rather than OpenAgents Launcher. Your settings, paired workspaces, credentials and agents carry over automatically. On macOS an in-place update keeps the existing application name; downloading the app again gives you the renamed bundle.
description.zh: 桌面应用、安装包与下载文件均已由 OpenAgents Launcher 更名为 OpenAgents。您的设置、已配对的工作区、凭据与智能体都会自动沿用，无需重新配置。macOS 上通过应用内更新升级的版本仍保留原有的应用名称，重新下载安装包即可获得更名后的版本。
